1.name: Offensive Stance
1.description: Shift into an offensive stance, increasing your Offense by 5 and Physical Damage dealt by 10%. Additionally, if you take damage while in this stance, you have a chance to gain Vengeance.

effects.stat: Offense by 5 and Physical Damage dealt

1.name: Rend I
1.description: Savagely rend your target, dealing 125% Weapon Ratio Damage plus 1 (L1) to 10 (L10) Physical Damage, increasing your Threat against them by 25 (L1) to 50 (L10), and granting you a chance to reset the cooldown of your Cleave, Feint, Frenzy and Shield Bash abilities.
1.valuesSummary: 125% weapon dmg · 1–10 Physical dmg (L1–L10) · +25–50 Threat against them (L1–L10)

2.name: Battle Cry
2.description: Embolden your group with a blood-curdling battle cry, increasing their Strength by 1 (L1) to 15 (L60) for 2 minutes.

3.name: Charge
3.description: Charge at your target, immobilizing them for 1 second.

4.name: Defensive Stance
4.description: Shift into an defensive stance, increasing your Defense by 5 and reducing Physical Damage recieved by 10%. Additionally, if you take damage while in this stance, you have a chance to gain Vengeance.

effects.stat: Defense by 5 and reducing Physical Damage recieved

5.name: Unnerving Shout
5.description: Debilitate nearby targets with an unnerving shout, reducing their Physical Damage dealt by 5% for 30 seconds.

6.name: Armor Break
6.description: Break the armor of your target, decreasing their Armor Class by 1 (L1) to 26 (L60) for 30 seconds. This ability stacks up to three times.

7.name: Distracting Taunt
7.description: Taunts nearby targets, drawing their attention. This ability is moderately difficult to resist.

8.name: Clobber
8.description: Brutally clobber your target, stunning them for 6 seconds.

8.name: Intimidation
8.description: Initimidate nearby targets, causing them to flee for 10 seconds. This ability has a slight chance to be removed by damage.

9.name: Challenging Arrow I
9.description: Fire an arrow of challenge at your taret, dealing 100% Weapon Ratio Damage plus 1 (L9) to 10 (L29) Physical Damage, and increasing your Threat against them by 30 (L9) to 100 (L29).
9.valuesSummary: 100% weapon dmg · 1–10 Physical dmg (L9–L29) · +30–100 Threat against them (L9–L29)

10.name: Rend II
10.description: Savagely rend your target, dealing 130% Weapon Ratio Damage plus 10 (L10) to 15 (L20) Physical Damage, increasing your Threat against them by 50 (L10) to 75 (L20), and granting you a chance to reset the cooldown of your Cleave, Feint, Frenzy and Shield Bash abilities.
10.valuesSummary: 130% weapon dmg · 10–15 Physical dmg (L10–L20) · +50–75 Threat against them (L10–L20)

10.name: Shield Bash I
10.description: Fiercely bash your target with a shield, dealing damage based on your shield's Armor Class plus 1 (L10) to 5 (L20) Physical Damage, increasing your Threat against them by 50 (L10) to 100 (L20), interrupting their casting, and preventing them from casting spells from the same school of magic for 4 seconds. This ability requires a shield.

11.name: Cross Cut
11.description: Cut through your target with dual weapons, dealing 70% Weapon Ratio Damage plus 5 (L1) to 10 (L21) Physical Damage per equipped weapon. This ability requires dual-wilded weapons. This ability shares a cooldown with other Might abilities.
11.valuesSummary: 70% weapon dmg · 5–10 Physical per equipped weapon dmg (L1–L21)

12.name: Kneebreaker
12.description: Smash the knees of your target, decreasing their Movement Speed by 50% for 8 seconds. This ability has diminishing returns when used in Pvp.

12.name: Shield Block I
12.description: Raise your shield in defence, absorbing 70 damage received for 5 seconds.

13.name: Frenzy I
13.description: Eviscerate your target with a frenzy of attacks, dealing 80% Weapon Ratio Damage up to five times and increasing your Attack Speed by 10% for 1 minute. This ability consumes one stack of Vengeance per strike. This ability shares a cooldown with Cleave and Feint.

14.name: Disarm
14.description: Disarm your target, temporarily removing their weapon and reducing their Physical Damage dealt by 10% for 8 seconds. This ability has diminishing returns when used in PvE.

15.name: Juggernaut
15.description: Charge at your target like a juggernaut, immobilizing them for 1 second. Additionally your Threat generation is increased by 20% and all damage received is reduced by 10% for 10 seconds.

15.name: Second Wind
15.description: Catch a second wind, restoring 10 (L15) to 50 (L60) Health every 2 seconds for 10 seconds. This ability consumes one stack of Vengeance. This ability scales with your Stamina.

16.name: Defense
16.description: Stand firm with unwavering defense, reducing Physical Damage received by 40% for 30 seconds.

18.name: Cleave I
18.description: Cleave through targets in a frontal cone, dealing 100% Weapon Ratio Damage plus 5 (L18) to 10 (L28) Physical Damage. This ability consumes one stack of Vengeance. This ability requires a two-handed weapon. This ability shares a cooldown with Feint and Frenzy.

20.name: Merciless Assault
20.description: Unleash a merciless assault, increasing your Physical Damage dealt by 50% and causing your melee attacks to always land Critical Hits for 12 seconds. If you are Berserk while this ability is active, your melee attacks always land Crippling Blows.
